title: SMAITE_XD TOTEM
description: A stylish Minecraft Totem resource pack that enhances your gameplay with a clean and unique design. Perfect for players who want a fresh and visually appealing look while keeping the vanilla feel.
body:
This Minecraft resource pack replaces the default Totem of Undying with a custom skin-based design.

The pack is simple and lightweight, only changing the totem texture while keeping the rest of the game fully vanilla. It is perfect for players who want a personalized touch without affecting gameplay.

Features:

- Custom Totem of Undying texture
- Clean and unique skin-based design
- Fully compatible with vanilla Minecraft
- No performance impact

If you enjoy small visual changes, this pack is a great choice to make your gameplay feel more personal.
